risks.risk: The internal motor or electronics may be faulty.

Video of the machine running and sewing a line of stitches.
Photo of the brand name/logo on the machine body.
Photo of the accessories and manual mentioned by the seller.
response.reason: The model EM81 is identified, allowing for a worst-case valuation as a non-functional, unbranded machine head despite the lack of full-body photos.
